title: Excellent
text:
The experience with Sergio and Sergio was fantastic from start to finish.
Both the guide and the driver were extremely kind, professional, and attentive throughout the entire day. The visit to Itálica, the Monastery of San Isidoro, and the Cartuja was fascinating, very well organized, and perfectly balanced.
In addition to the quality of the explanations, I also want to highlight the friendliness and availability of both throughout the entire morning.
author: Vacation64197378990

title: Italica, Sevilla
text: Tour of Italica & the cathedral in Sevilla was excellent. Our driver & tour guide were punctual & very professional. We rode in an beautiful & clean Mercedes van. Driver had cold water bottles for us. We also got to see Plaza de España.
author: Frankutset
